bioconda.summary: An end-to-end workflow for focal amplification analysis with AmpliconArchitect.

commands: python3 -c "from importlib.metadata import requires; assert any(r.lower().startswith('gurobipy') for r in requires('BFBArchitect'))"
python3 -c "from importlib.metadata import version; assert version('AmpliconClassifier') == '2.0.0'"
python3 -c "from pulp import COIN_CMD; assert COIN_CMD().available()"
python3 -c "from bfbarchitect.BFBSolver import reconstruct_BFB_cbc; sequence, objective = reconstruct_BFB_cbc([2], [0], [0], 1, max_time=30, max_threads=1); assert sequence and objective is not None"
